title: nephrodium mascarense
intro: Nephrodium mascarense, commonly known as Indian brake, is a type of plant that belongs to the fern family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, lowering blood pressure, and acting as an antioxidant. The health benefits of Nephrodium mascarense are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
